Moderna got kicked out of the Nasdaq-100. Now it's back.
Moderna rejoined the Nasdaq-100 on Oct 9, 2026, replacing Warner Bros. Discovery, and the same day its stock closed up 14% at $225.
It ended 2025 near $30 a share, a gain of more than 600% in 2026, after its Merck-partnered cancer vaccine hit its main goal in a late-stage trial in August.
Nasdaq dropped it in December 2024, after the stock fell nearly 60% that year. Index funds follow rules, not hunches.
Sources: Nasdaq, Yahoo Finance, Benzinga, Morningstar (Oct 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
